notes.title: Scream Fest Update Part 1
notes.notes:
Welcome to part 1 of our Scream Fest Update! Here is what has changed from the previous version:

[b]DIALOGUE[/b]
Added Skip Dialogue Feature (both in replicated and non-replicated dialogues)
Fixed issue where mouse wouldn't disappear between player choices
Player camera now focuses NPC when initiating dialogue and speaking to the NPC

[b]OTHERS[/b]
Added Current status in lobby
You can toggle lights inside of the lobby by pressing on them
Re-added the Plague Doctor Limited Edition Skin Bundle to the game - for deluxe supporters
Added Two Slides Animations for the Slides inside of the poolrooms

[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]
Fixed Issue where you could pick up the same blueprint - which would cause blueprint replication inside of the crafting table
Fixed Issue where Clients couldn't turn on/off lights in Level -1 "The Infinite Graveyard"
Fixed Issue Where Copper was huge when deposited on a shelf - quite the funny bug
Fixed glitched subtitles for the intro cutscene
Fixed UI for Inviting Friends in Lobby when no friends were online
Multiplayer improvements

[h3]Loading screens and times[/h3]
[list]
[*] Saving and loading system has been fully remade from scratch, with the new multiplayer system which made us achieve shorter loading screens for both server and clients while fixing some replication issues as well
[*] Added a Loading screen before starting the game inside the lobby
[/list]

[h3]Slides[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added slides animations and a slides animation modular system, which will make slides animation possible everywhere in the future. Currently you can find the slide around in poolrooms and soon we will have them all across the levels as a way of traveling through areas
[*] Coming soon: Slide animations when traveling between levels
[/list]

[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] New main menu song and main Infinitum Theme
[*] Footsteps system has been remade (footsteps sound correctly now from distance and sound changes accordingly if sound is behind a wall)
[*] Added sfx for placing a Colour Capsule inside a Colour Terminal
[*] Added sfx for going down the slide
[/list]

[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]
[list]
[*] A big addition to this new update is the way we handle multiplayer. Keeping things short, before this update the server was initiating and doing everything for the clients, which would take quite some time because it would have to update the variables(world data) every time before initiating an event. With this new update, we made it so that the variables update on each person playing, meaning that after joining someone's world, everyone has a temporary variable with the save stored up in their own game. When interacting with the world the game checks on each client's computer if he is able to give access to certain things instead of waiting for confirmations from the server.
[/list]

[h3]Crafting/Building[/h3]
[list]
[*] We are currently having some issues with crafting and building, so while some of the bugs were fixed we think there are more ways you can make this system glitch, so please let us kindly know about any of the issues you find 
[*] 
[/list]

[h3]Bugs Fixed:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Clients not being able to give Mr Kitty the cute item
[*] Mr Kitty appearing differently on each player
[*] Fixed Outside lights from level 974 not working for clients
[*] Fixed bug where stamina would decrease when jumping if you were crouched(the jump wouldn't happen in this case but you would lose stamina)
[*] Fixed bug where taking damage more than two times in less than a second would bug the PP effect on the screen
[*] Fixed bug where clients could not take the notebook from the Laboratory
[*] Fixed issues related to Colour Capsules not being able to be unlocked
[/list]

Note: Because of this update we had to redo most of code on how multiplayer is handled, which is why this update took so long to come out. In return for making people wait this long, we did our best with remaking some of the levels and adding a new level to the game while also fixing some of the main issues like the lights in Level 974. There still might be some multiplayer issues we overlooked, if found any, please let us know in the discord server and we will take care of all of them for the next update. Big thanks to all our supporters on Patreon and Ko-fi who made development along the months possible, you guys are the best.

notes.title: The Story Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Infinitum Alpha 0.2.1 is now here![/h1]

[h3]Bunker[/h3]
-Added the Bunker, a structure which spawns in most levels and is part of the new saving system, your progress only saves when entering the bunker, think of this as a "safe room" and of course when doing any changes inside it (changing your bunker name or lights)
-Portal has been moved inside the Bunker and finding parts needed to start it now save (For example you can find Calum and put it inside the bunker and leave, next time when you come inside the bunker, Calum is still there)
-In order to build the portal, you need to find 27 servers which can be randomly found around the levels and the 3 Items (Calum, Henna and Solis)
-Introduced 7 Color capsules(Items) which can be found inside the levels and when put inside the bunker, you can customize the lights color inside the bunker
-The Bunker is planned to be a highly customizable place, currently you can customize the light colors and your bunker name, which is show on the walls

[h3]Story/Cutscenes[/h3]
-In order to build the portal you will need to find the 3 power sources and 27 servers which can be found randomly around the levels
-Introduced the intro part of the Story, proper cutscenes and the Infinitum Lab
-Introduced tutorial area with a proper tutorial for new players
-Cutscenes and tutorial area contain voice-lines and subtitles

[h3]Cats[/h3]
-Added cats to the game!
-1 cat can be found in each one of the 5 levels, so there are 5 different cats to be found
-Once a cat is found you can Adopt/tame it
-Adopted cats can be found inside the bunker
-In the future you will be able to add cosmetics to the cats and maybe take 1 cat with you and having a bonus, a 5% speed boost for example

[h3]InfoBook:[/h3]
-Updated levels, entities and exits with more details to help the player understand the game more

[h3]Entities:[/h3]
-Entities Ai, jumpscare animations and dead bodies left behind have been worked on and improved
New entity: Statues (something similar to Weeping Angels)
-can be found in poolrooms, they move at night and when the player is not looking at them.
-when getting too close during the night they will transform you into stone(with a proper animation which can be seen by other players)

[h3]Items:[/h3]
-New consuming sounds for a few items
-Added Pool keys(New item which can be used to open locked doors inside poolrooms)
-Item Icons appear now as sketches

[h3]Quests:[/h3]
-Added quests to the game, a free way of earning cosmetics/skins through progressing in the game/ finding things, you can consider these as side objectives to the story.
-There are currently 6 quests which offer 6 different Hazmat Suit Colors


[h3]New Feature: Levels travel Adaptation:[/h3]
-Traveling to a new level now adapts depending where you're coming from.
-As an example, if you take the escalators in Level 0 to get to Level 33, you will get spawned in Level 33 but behind you will be escalators which will take you back to Level 0 if you want to go back there again. Levels In Infinitum are not meant to be "completed", you are exploring a new world and the more you learn about it the faster you will be able to travel between these levels, completing your objectives and building your own story.
-This feature is not fully implemented yet but it has been implemented fully for the bunker (exiting a bunker will take you to the level you came from and next to you you will find the bunker)

[h3]Others:[/h3]
-Improved areas design where you can find the items needed to open the portal
-Introduced seamless travel, which should make traveling and loading times a lot faster and also fix all traveling between levels bugs
-When dying players drop their items now (before they would just disappear)"
-Everyone who participated in the Christmas event and placed well has now received their rewards
-Performance Improvements
-Screen popups now have sounds (notebook updated, achievement/quests completed)
-Added text chat and voice chat inside the lobby
-Added "Invite friends" feature inside lobbies
-World saves can now be played both as singleplayer and multiplayer
-Stamina system and hunger/thirst balance changes

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
-a TON of bug fixes ranging from ui and main menu to loading screens and generation, please report any bugs you find in the discord server

Planned features: Cats accessories and more animations, small building system inside the bunker to build shelves/crates to hold your items, and many more! These can be done only with the help of the kickstarter so if you enjoyed Infinitum just a little, have the possibility and would like to support this solo developer please consider suporting the kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/infinitumgame/infinitum-the-backrooms-story?ref=discovery

-The demo will be releasing on 20 december

- Multiplayer
- 5 playable levels(4 infinite) ( Level 0,Level 2< Level 33, Level 37, Level 974)

- character customization
- fully functional main menu with different gamemodes (exploration, normal, creative, hardcore)
- inventory with items and items animations
- different exits between levels
Before the demo release I also plan on adding the following
- The story (work on this is almost done it will be added to the demo 100%)
- Facelings
- Achievements and quests
- voice chat
- more items and different content in levels
- Christmas event (win free exclusive items)
and many more!

[i][b]If any of these are not finished for the demo release, the demo will still be release but it will be updated in the following days with the remaining content. I apologise for any game-breaking bugs in advance, this game was made by 1 person and I am working daily on it and will post daily bug fixing updates after the demo release.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Infinitum: Pre Alpha 0.9.0 LEVEL 33 UPDATE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44264256/e44e9b753d0e14b47515a52f37c48f2319e23db1.png[/img]
[h2]Infinitum Pre Alpha 0.9.0 Update! We are approaching the Demo Release on 20 December![/h2]

[h2]Patchnotes:[/h2]

[h3]Level 33 Is now here![/h3]

- Level 33 is an Infinite mall where the more you go in any direction the more this level decays and
looks more destroyed. Currently this level has 6 stages of decay, each one having a different
ambience which can be heard through the megaphones found around the mall
- You can enter this Level by finding the new room in level 0 with Escalators
- Added randomly locked doors
- Added Mall Keys item, you can find it in the shops around the spawn
- This level will contain the facelings, which will make their first appereance in the next update on 26 November

[h3]Inventory system remade from scratch![/h3]
- You can now Carry up to 16 items
- You can now carry up to 18 batteries
- New 3d UI for the Inventory, this inventory updates the character animations as well while using it

[b]The Customization System[/b] is now here along with the Halloween Event Rewards!
I previously mentioned that the 1st place will get a special Item and top 10 will get an exclusive witch hat cosmetic item, but because of the amount of people that joined this event, the top 1 will receive it's special item and top 50 people from the leaderboard will receive the witch hat

- Added text chat, you can now text with people while playing the game by pressing enter!
- The issue with the keybinds has been fixed now and you can change your keybinds in the settings menu
- The interaction system has been remade completely from scratch which will make adding new interactable items a lot easier!
- Lowered spawn rate for batteries and items but in return added more spawn points. This was changed in order to maximize the level generation randomization
- Added loading screen when opening the game which displays the current version you are playing and the game logo along with a main menu smooth tranzition
- Added screen pop up messages to the bottom of the screen when standing next to exits ( In the following updated I will make small additions like this to help new players understand the game faster )
- Added Almond Water texture

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed a bug in multiplayer where interactable object would have no sound effects on clients
- Fixed but with infinite black screen when launching the game
- Fixed VHS overlay bad texture
+ Many smaller fixes

Please note that this update might have performance issues, bad textures, wrong models or anything that can be considered a glitch or a bug so I will be updating the game in the next few days with updates addressing these issues, please report any bug on the discord server specific forum.

Interested in Pre Alpha testing? More info at: https://www.patreon.com/posts/90598880?pr=true
